purpose: The patch changes fwnode APIs to accept error pointers, letting callers pass results of functions that may return ERR_PTR() without extra NULL/ERR checks, simplifying code and avoiding missed error handling.
Updates QCOM QMP PHY device tree binding docs to correct child node description from per‑lane to per‑PHY.

The commit introduces core code structures in the AMD display driver to support Firmware Assisted Memory Switching (FAMS), laying groundwork in the DC layer before the feature can be enabled in amdgpu_dm.
Adds #ifdef guards around two drm/ttm lines that assume real x86 hardware, enabling the driver to compile when the kernel is built for ARCH=um (user‑mode Linux).
Adds const qualifier to qcom_icc_bcm pointer declarations, ensuring they cannot be modified and improving safety.
The patch corrects the handling of 64‑bit arguments in SBI PMU calls when compiled for 32‑bit RISC‑V, ensuring proper register usage and correct values on RV32 platforms.
The commit updates perf's CPU map handling to use the perf_cpu_map library API instead of direct raw accesses, improving reference‑count handling and consistency with BPF code.

The patch introduces tracepoints into DMA allocation/free paths, refactors the code to funnel allocations through a single tracepoint, and records the actual allocating function for better debugging of memory violations.
The commit refactors the cs42l42 driver by dividing probe() and remove() into distinct stages and adding an init_done flag to handle SoundWire enumeration constraints.
The commit adds a device‑tree node for the Qualcomm SC7280 Data Capture and Compare (DCC) hardware, providing its compatible string and register address to enable kernel support for this peripheral.

The patch refactors const handling in the iwlwifi driver, replacing direct const‑to‑void* casts with uintptr_t casts and removing unnecessary const‑dropping casts for dma_map_single(), to satisfy stricter compiler checks.
The patch refactors the s390/vfio-ap driver to obtain queue devices via the AP bus's ap_get_qdev() lookup instead of iterating a device list, leveraging a hash‑table for faster access.
The commit corrects handling of zero‑length NFSv4.2 CLONE operations when a delegation is held, using the server's GETATTR size instead of incorrectly setting the inode size to zero.
Implements a get_snr() macro for the wcn36xx driver, extracting SNR from BD descriptors to support future mac80211 survey operations.
The patch updates raid5 stripe_head handling to fully initialize embedded bios with bio_init, replacing partial init, manual dev/op settings, and bio_reset, simplifying the setup.
The commit removes an unnecessary backslash at the end of a line in the spr_cstates[] array definition within the intel_idle driver, cleaning up the source without altering functionality.
Adds CONFIG_OBJTOOL and replaces CONFIG_STACK_VALIDATION references, making stack validation an optional objtool feature; primarily a build‑config refactor.
The patch changes two variables in moxart_ether.c from generic u32 to the explicit little‑endian __le32 type, addressing Sparse warnings about incorrect endianness handling.
The commit corrects a misspelled word in the SCSI documentation, altering only the text and not changing any code or behavior.
Patch changes the GPPLL fractional‑N clock MFD register from 0 to 1, aligning with spec that 0 is disallowed.

The patch modifies kill_accessing_process() in mm/hwpoison to return -EHWPOISON when a page is already poisoned, fixing the wrong error code that caused a spurious "Memory error not recovered" log and duplicate SIGBUS delivery.
Updates the nvmem snvs-lpgpr DT binding docs to show i.MX8M compatible strings also include the fallback fsl,imx7d-snvs-lpgpr, documenting both options.
The commit deletes a dev_err call that was redundant because devm_ioremap_resource already reports errors, thus removing duplicate error messages.

The commit adds handling for multicast router (mrouter) ports in the sparx5 network driver, ensuring they join all active multicast groups and override disabled flooding, enabling proper multicast forwarding.
The commit renames the struct xilinx_pcie_port to xilinx_pcie throughout the driver to follow the <driver>_pcie naming convention, without altering any functionality.
The commit deletes a verbose debug printk from the Qualcomm QMP combo PHY init routine, cleaning up unnecessary logging in the driver.
The commit revises the GPIO IR LED device‑tree bindings, converting them to the new DT schema format, updating the binding documentation to follow schema conventions.
The commit modifies unx_lookup_cred() to use the same mempool allocation strategy as rpc_malloc(), correcting an allocation problem in the SUNRPC subsystem.
Adds documentation for two new sc8280xp compatible devices (CRD and Lenovo Thinkpad X13s) in the arm/qcom dt-bindings.
Adds a device‑tree node for the SM8150 Ethernet QOS controller, correcting interrupt numbers and adding its power‑domain, enabling kernel support for the Ethernet hardware.
The patch replaces a hard‑coded value 9 with the PAGE_SECTORS_SHIFT macro in block code and removes an unnecessary cast, making the code clearer and relying on compiler‑generated casting.
The patch updates the s390 DASD driver to create its sysfs entries via the kobj_type default_groups field instead of the deprecated default_attrs, aligning with the newer kobject API.

The patch replaces custom read‑modify‑write code in the i915 DVO enable/disable paths with the generic intel_de_rmw() helper and switches to intel_de_posting_read() for posting reads, consolidating register access logic.
The patch deletes the hisilicon,hi6220-reset dt-binding because the related controllers are already documented, removing redundant documentation.
The commit reverts a previous addition of pipe1 hardware support because it caused graphics hangs on Navi 21 with GNOME Wayland, restoring prior behavior to fix the regression.

The patch introduces a small wrapper struct to hold the __iomem pointer, replacing a generic void* in pci_config_window.priv, eliminating sparse static‑analysis warnings about address‑space mismatches.

The patch extends the CRIU PROCESS_INFO ioctl in the amdkfd driver to report the number of SVM ranges and their total private data size, enabling future checkpoint/restore support for shared virtual memory.

The patch adds a new boolean 'submission_initialized' flag to the i915 GuC driver and uses it to track submission setup, replacing the previous check that depended on the LRC descriptor pool which is being removed.

Adjusts the auipc+jalr relocation range checks for RISC-V to correctly handle the signed 32‑bit offset, fixing overflow errors when the offset approaches the limits of the 20‑bit and 12‑bit immediates.
Adds a check for clk_enable() return value in davinci_mmc driver and returns an error on failure, ensuring proper error handling.
The patch adds missing asterisks in comment block delimiters of trace_events_hist.c, correcting formatting and silencing clang warnings about bad lines.
The patch enlarges the static name array in the Exynos MCT driver from length 10 to a larger size so that each CPU's local timer interrupt can be printed correctly when the SoC has 12 or more timers.

The patch updates KVM PPC Book3S HV handling of the decrementer during VM migration. Previously a workaround set an absolute expiry; after changing to guest‑timebase‑relative expiry, the initialization must also be relative, otherwise the vCPU hangs. The commit adjusts this initialization to prevent the hang.

The patch modifies f2fs to store io_flags in the bio structure, ensuring that I/O merging respects the original flags and prevents unnecessary splitting caused by differing op_flags among fio holders.

The patch streamlines the compound_range_next() helper in the gup code by removing a redundant order check and replacing PageCompound() with PageHead(), since a compound page always has order >=1 and cannot be a tail page.
The patch removes the HAL_DEF_IS_SUPPORT_ANT_DIV case from GetHalDefVar8188EUsb() in the r8188eu driver and moves that logic into a new function, continuing the removal of the legacy HAL layer.
The patch corrects the handling of DSC bits_per_pixel in the MSM DPU1 driver, using the 6.4 fractional format directly instead of the previous incorrect integer‑only math.
The commit changes the perf test suite to use the thloop workload instead of the previous record test workload, removing the need for a compiler during testing.

Adds a check in hci_cmd_sync_queue to return an error when the HCI_UNREGISTER flag is set, preventing commands from being queued after the device is being unregistered, which could otherwise cause a use‑after‑free.
Adds a likely() annotation to ICE_XDP_REDIR and its callsite, guiding the compiler to treat XDP_REDIRECT as the common case, thus improving branch prediction and generated code speed.
The patch invalidates unresolved unicast neighbour entries for broadcast addresses when the kernel adds the matching broadcast route, eliminating stale entries that caused packet drops.
The patch deletes an unnecessary `asm/termios.h` include from n_hdlc.c, because the file already includes linux/tty.h which pulls in the proper termios header, simplifying the include hierarchy.
The commit makes brcmstb_reset() static in the sdhci-brcmstb driver, eliminating a -Wmissing-prototypes compiler warning.
The commit deletes unused guest PASID UAPI interfaces and definitions from the IOMMU subsystem because they are unreferenced and will be replaced by a new iommufd design, eliminating dead code.
Adds a check for mmc_add_host()'s return value in the moxart MMC driver; on failure it jumps to an error path that calls mmc_free_host(), preventing a memory leak and kernel crash.
The patch replaces the undefined __umoddi3 operator in the AMD GPU driver with div_u64_rem, fixing a link error when compiling the driver for 32‑bit i386.
The patch modifies the MSCC MACsec driver to stop copying encryption keys when setting up a flow, eliminating the need to zero them later and reducing the risk of key remnants in memory.
Switches vhost/vsock packet allocation from kmalloc to kvmalloc/kvfree to avoid allocation failures for large (≈1 MiB) packets, fixing crashes observed during large SFTP transfers.
The patch disables the RX error interrupt in the dp83822 driver to stop an interrupt flood caused by the RCSR register filling up when the cable is disconnected.
Adds a compatible string for the Aries Embedded M100PFSEVP SOM/EVK platform to the RISC‑V Microchip dt‑bindings, documenting support for this new hardware.

The commit adds runtime DSP path creation and freeing for Intel AVS ASoC driver, using topology templates to dynamically allocate IDs during hw_params and release them on hw_free, enabling PCM operations.
The patch adds a flush_tlb call after updating page table entries for VG20 GPUs with XGMI bridges, preventing stale TLB entries cached in the translation cache from causing stalls.

The commit adds support for the Allwinner H616 USB PHY by defining a new configuration structure that captures its unique properties and registers a new compatible string, extending the sun4i-usb PHY driver to handle this SoC.
Adds support for the IVO M133NW4J-R3 eDP panel by creating a new panel entry in drm/panel-edp, using generic delay_200_500_p2e100 timings as a temporary placeholder.
Renames the KVM self‑test file evmcs_test to hyperv_evmcs, aligning it with Hyper‑V naming conventions and removing the redundant _test suffix.
The patch adds the static keyword to the of_match_tables definitions in the Arizona MFD driver after splitting them for I2C and SPI, making the tables internal to the compilation unit.
Adds infrastructure for KPP template instances: defines struct kpp_instance, implements kpp_register_instance and helper functions, and documents them, enabling future template-based KPP algorithms.
The patch reorders imx‑rngc driver init: it clears the IRQ mask before registering the IRQ handler, preventing a premature completion that caused a kernel crash during boot.
The commit removes unnecessary supply and clock description entries from the Qualcomm QMP PHY device tree binding files, simplifying the documentation without altering functional behavior.
Updates dt-binding documentation for AD7923/AD7924/AD7927 to note driver compatibility and relationship, without changing code.
The commit raises the HID driver’s maximum LED brightness for the Dream Cheeky device to 63, correcting an incorrect limit and enabling full brightness as verified on the hardware.
The patch adds a check in mvebu_pcie_hw_rd_conf() for invalid read sizes, returning all-ones and PCIBIOS_BAD_REGISTER_NUMBER, mirroring the write path handling.
Removes the custom bit_reverse() function and replaces it with the standard bitrev8() from linux/bitrev.h plus a bitshift, eliminating duplicated code.

The patch moves the early TLB flush (local_flush_tlb_all) to run right after pt‑walker setup and before page allocation on LoongArch, and relocates a pgtable bits define function into tlb_init, fixing a boot failure of the second kernel after kexec/kdump on SMP systems.
Adds a cache for extent sharedness checks during fiemap in Btrfs, avoiding repeated tree traversals and improving performance.
Updates perf c2c documentation to describe the newly added store metric value 'N/A', aligning the report table description with current behavior.

The patch moves the definitions of mach_get_rtc_pll, mach_set_rtc_pll and mach_hwclk into the time.c path for nommu m68k builds, ensuring they are compiled where needed and eliminating undefined reference errors.
The patch adds code to release enclosure device objects when the mpi3mr driver is unloaded and before rescanning targets on controller reset, preventing resource leaks.
The patch fixes race conditions and lock handling for hugetlb vmas during splitting and unmapping, preventing double frees and ensuring proper lock presence for VM_MAYSHARE vmas.
The patch enables a process created with vfork+exec to change its time namespace, by allowing the exec step to perform the namespace switch even when the child shares the parent's memory (CLONE_VM).
The patch deletes the per‑CPU conntrack dying list, moving entries to a per‑net list, and adjusts when the IPS_CONFIRMED flag is set to avoid double unlinking.
Removes a duplicated 'is' word in a comment of the ab8500_fg power supply driver, fixing a typo.
The commit adds a function to the DesignWare I2C driver that reads I2C timing parameters from firmware, mirroring similar logic in the PCI driver, enabling dynamic timing configuration.
The patch adds the X86_FEATURE_XENPV flag to the list of features handled specially in disabled-features.h, enabling the kernel to recognize this Xen PV feature.
The patch reverts damage caused by the return‑thunk mitigation on x86, adding a X86_FEATURE_RETHUNK flag to selectively disable it for affected CPUs.
Updates the ASoC dt-binding for the Realtek rt5682s codec to document AVDD and MICVDD supplies, matching their use in existing device tree files.

The patch removes redundant re‑initialisation of control arrays in set_mba_sc() for the resctrl MBA software controller, moving the mbps_val[] reset to reset_all_ctrls() and eliminating unnecessary architecture‑specific accesses.
Renames the struct `vkms_composer` to `vkms_frame_info` in the vkms driver, updating all code references to reflect that it holds frame composition information.
The patch changes framebuffer console (fbcon) sysfs attribute show functions to use sysfs_emit instead of snprintf/scnprintf, aligning with the recommended API for sysfs output.

The patch removes code in the USB gadget core that assigns udc->dev.driver, preventing a race where dev_uevent dereferences a driver pointer that may be cleared, fixing a use‑after‑free bug reported by syzbot.
Adds a missing iounmap() call in zorro7xx_remove_one() to correctly release I/O memory mapped during probe, fixing a resource leak.
The patch renames the driver’s set_fmt_new function back to set_fmt after the ASoC core switched to a new direct‑clock API, allowing the driver to use the standard set_fmt callback again.
The patch reorders logic in the r8188eu driver's OnDisassoc function, extracting the non‑access‑point handling before the main conditional block to make the code clearer.

Adds intel_async_flip_check_uapi() called early in atomic check to verify async flip capability and performs basic checks (CRTC active, modeset flag, plane enabled) to ensure validity of async flip requests.
The patch removes kernel-doc annotations from static functions in drm/edid, considering them excessive, and replaces them with plain comments, without altering any functional code.

The commit updates the spear-keyboard driver to replace deprecated SIMPLE_DEV_PM_OPS() with DEFINE_SIMPLE_DEV_PM_OPS() together with pm_sleep_ptr(), removing __maybe_unused annotations and silencing compiler warnings.
The patch adds logic in the RDMA core to compute the UDP source port from the GRH flow label, falling back to lqpn/rqpn when the flow label is absent.
The commit adds support for the on‑board RT711 SDCA audio codec on the Intel Meteor Lake (MTL) platform, integrating it into the ASoC Intel SOF driver.

The patch modifies intel_gt_mcr_wait_for_reg_fw() to manage uncore->lock internally, fixing a race where callers didn't hold the lock, which could cause lockdep assertions, and releases the lock during long waits to avoid blocking other MMIO.
Adds support for a new ACPI identifier for the AMD PMC controller, updating the driver’s ACPI ID table to recognize the new hardware version.
The patch updates the r8188eu driver to call the generic ieee80211_get_DA helper instead of its own get_da function, aligning the code with the common wireless stack API.
Adds a new compatible string “elan,eth3915n” to the input touchscreen dt‑bindings, enabling the kernel to recognize the eth3915n controller as compatible with ekth3500.
Replace scnprintf with sysfs_emit in the sfc driver to follow sysfs guidelines, ensuring proper formatting for values returned to user space.
Adds support for Intel LBR format V7 in perf, introducing shared capability flags in x86_pmu and an init routine to set them, simplifying capability checks for Goldmont+ and Tremont CPUs.
The patch consolidates two LED state structures (struct led_priv and struct LED_871x) in the r8188eu driver by moving fields from LED_871x into led_priv, simplifying the LED layer.
The commit adjusts the NFP driver to correctly handle a 32‑bit capability register that may be placed at a non‑qword‑aligned address, preventing illegal unaligned I/O reads on certain architectures.

Adds validation in nf_tables to ensure NFT_SET_CONCAT flag is set when field_count is provided, and rejects inconsistent usage with EINVAL, aligning flag semantics with recent set concatenation support.
Tag commit marking Linux 6.2 release candidate 1; no source code modifications.
The patch removes the over‑restrictive block on APIC writes for non‑ICR registers, allowing x2APIC MSR writes needed by x2AVIC, thus correcting a regression introduced by a previous change.
The patch corrects the TLV length check in tipc_nl_compat_name_table_dump_header by adding proper casting, preventing negative values and fixing the uninitialized‑value bug reported by syzbot.
Adds a new compatible string for the Altera SoCFPGA Stratix 10 Development Kit in the arm64 device tree, enabling kernel support for this board.

The commit adds avdd-0v9-supply and avdd-1v8-supply properties to the HDMI node in the rk3399-roc-pc device tree, matching the hardware schematic and silencing a kernel warning about missing supplies.
Renames the KUnit test configuration option for the IIO format test suite to follow the required CONFIG_<name>_KUNIT_TEST naming pattern.

The patch updates the KVM arm64 self‑test to set debug.control using the proper KVM_GUESTDBG_ENABLE constant instead of the test‑only SINGLE_STEP_DISABLE enum, which coincidentally had the same value, clarifying intent without changing behavior.
The commit updates the Qualcomm GSBI device‑tree binding by converting its documentation to the new dtschema format, aligning it with the DT schema specification.
Splits sd_read_protection into two functions, moves integrity probing to the end of SCSI device discovery, removes a redundant revalidate call, and makes log output less verbose.
The commit adds device‑tree entries for the RZ/G2UL SMARC board to enable the SSI1 audio interface, updating pinctrl and sound_dai nodes.
The commit removes the driver‑enforced edge‑rising interrupt trigger, letting the Device Tree specify the type, fixing bind failures on Qualcomm WCN3990 where the DTSI uses level‑high.

Reverts a recent move of proc_dointvec_minmax_sysadmin() that added an incorrect __user qualifier to its buffer argument, fixing the sparse static‑analysis warning and restoring the proper kernel pointer type.
Adds a GPIO interrupt handler and implements irq_chip helper functions (irq_ack, irq_mask, irq_unmask, irq_set_type) for the microchip pci1xxxx driver, enabling proper IRQ configuration and handling.
Deletes the unused 'work' member from struct mlx5e_async_ctx in the mlx5e driver, cleaning dead code.

The patch changes rxrpc congestion handling: it stops persisting cwnd across calls, resets to the initial cwnd after an idle RTT, and preserves ssthresh, fixing a situation where a saved cwnd of 0 prevented any transmission.
The patch relocates several root helper functions from accessors.h back to ctree.h, restoring proper file organization and simplifying synchronization with btrfs-progs.
The commit adds a software function to support the new SMUIO hardware block in the AMDGPU driver, extending discovery code for version 13.0.9.
The patch raises the maximum DRAM bandwidth percentage for the DCN315 display engine to 60%, mirroring DCN31, to resolve DML validation failures when multiple HDR displays are connected.

The patch corrects the 4 GB boundary check in the mpt3sas SCSI driver by using the DMA address of the memory pool instead of the virtual address, ensuring proper handling of DMA buffers that cross the 4 GB limit.
Adds a new DT binding gpio property for wcd938x codec to select CTIA/OMTP headset configuration.
The patch modifies mlx5e_fs_init() to invoke mlx5e_fs_vlan_free(fs) before kvfree(fs), eliminating a use‑after‑free bug in the mlx5e network driver.
Fixes use‑after‑free when a station disconnects on QCA6390/WCN6855 by adjusting the peer‑delete sequence to avoid skipping necessary cleanup.
The patch deletes the unused function rxrpc_get_reply_time() from the RxRPC subsystem because the code now uses the call issue time instead, cleaning up dead code.
The commit updates the maintainer email address in the dt-bindings documentation, replacing the old address with Luca Ceresoli's preferred Bootlin address.
The commit corrects the probe() function in the MPFS MUSB driver so that error paths return proper negative error codes instead of zero, ensuring failures are reported correctly.

Moves netdev_notifier registration from each device probe to module initialization, preventing duplicate registration when multiple ADIN1110/2111 devices are present, eliminating probe warnings/failures.
The patch removes the JFS ->writepage callback, which was inefficient and only a fallback, and sets ->migrate_folio to the generic buffer‑head helper, deleting the writepage implementation.

Adds support for a new queue allocation command required by newer firmware, refactors the queue allocation API to use a station mask and revised flags, and implements removal of queues before station removal.
Adds a helper function virt_get_pte_hva() that returns the host virtual address of a page‑table entry for a given guest virtual address, intended for aarch64 KVM self‑tests.
The commit removes obsolete perfbuf API functions from libbpf and tidies up related option structures, simplifying the interface and eliminating dead code.

The patch adds a USB‑audio quirk for the Fiero SC‑01 device when running firmware version 1.0.0, reusing the quirks already defined for firmware 1.1.0 to handle hard‑coded sample rates, thereby enabling the driver to support that older firmware.
The patch stops running task work at the beginning of io_uring_enter, deferring it until after submissions to enable better batching, and adjusts related paths for SQPOLL, IOPOLL, and cqring wait.
Updates OMAP3 device‑tree to group CM_ICLKEN_WKUP clocks under the TI clksel binding and adds clock-output-names, removing unique_unit_address and node_name_chars_strict warnings.
The commit corrects a misspelled word in a comment inside the ocfs2 filesystem code, without changing any executable code.
The patch rewrites try_to_free_swap to operate on a folio instead of a page, eliminating extra compound_head calls and shrinking the kernel text by about 74 bytes.
Changes cfg80211_auth_request.key_idx from unsigned to signed to allow -1 sentinel value, removing static analysis warnings.
The patch adds a 'reset' argument to the mtk_wed_tx_ring_setup function, enabling the driver to handle reset operations for the Wireless Ethernet Dispatcher.
Adds admin capability checks to NVMe management ioctl commands (reset, rescan, etc.), aligning them with passthrough restrictions to stop unprivileged users from performing disruptive operations.
The patch ensures that during CRIU restore the AMD KFD driver recreates SDMA queues with the same SDMA ID that was saved at dump time, preserving correct queue identity.
The patch deletes the HW_VAR_AC_PARAM_VI hardware variable from SetHwReg8188EU() in the r8188eu driver and replaces its use with a direct rtw_write32() call, simplifying register configuration.
The patch updates drivers/bus/mhi/host/init.c to use sysfs_emit/sysfs_emit_at instead of snprintf, fixing a Coccinelle warning about using snprintf in sysfs code.
The commit updates the OMAP3 device tree to group CONTROL_DEVCONF0 clocks using the TI clksel binding and adds clock-output-names, eliminating unique_unit_address and node_name_chars_strict warnings.
The commit introduces a pinctrl/GPIO driver for Intel Meteor Lake, adding support for the new generation GPIO hardware while keeping compatibility with existing Intel pinctrl infrastructure.
The commit moves QCS404 remote processor PAS device‑tree bindings into a dedicated file, separating them from other bindings to simplify the tree and aid maintenance.
Adds clock name definitions for the Qualcomm SDM845 camera clock controller in the device‑tree binding schema, allowing the driver to parse the bi‑tcxo clock supplied via DT.
Changes the dsa_switch struct's num_ports field from size_t (8 bytes) to unsigned int (4 bytes) to remove padding and shrink the struct size, improving memory usage.
Removes unnecessary chip type comments from the FTDI serial driver, cleaning up the source without altering functionality.
The commit updates rxe_av.c to replace all calls to the generic pr_* debug macros with the rxe-specific rxe_dbg_* macros, aligning debug output with the RXE driver’s naming convention.
Limits RAS feature enable to the GFX IP block by removing a generic inline check and directly testing for GFX, aligning driver behavior with hardware requirements.
Updates the MAINTAINERS file to delete Jukka Rissanen as the 6lowpan maintainer, reflecting his departure from the project.
The patch initializes the previously uninitialized variable ‘next’ in find_first_clear_extent_bit, removing a compile‑time error in the btrfs code.

The patch adds bookkeeping to the i915 buddy allocator to record total visible memory and per‑resource visible usage, exposing it for debug output and future eviction decisions, plus minor code clean‑ups.

Adds a common mechanism for CXL.mem endpoint drivers to enumerate ancestor CXL switch ports, acquire parent port locks, and validate CXL.mem links, enabling proper port creation and teardown handling.

The patch deletes the unused function fscrypt_set_test_dummy_encryption() after its callers were switched to fscrypt_parse_test_dummy_encryption() and fscrypt_add_test_dummy_key(), cleaning up dead code in the fscrypt subsystem.

The patch updates the hisi_acc VFIO driver to use new device lifecycle helper functions, moves migration‑specific initialization from the probe routine to a dedicated init callback, and deletes the now‑unused vfio_pci_core_{un}init_device() functions.

The commit refactors btrfs I/O handling by removing unnecessary parameters (orig_bio, clone) from submit_stripe_bio, deriving them internally from existing data, thus simplifying the function signature.

The commit updates the Renesas r8a77470 pinctrl driver to replace full reserved register field descriptions with compact shorthands (negative width) and merges adjacent reserved fields, reducing the compiled kernel size.

The patch reorders the frequency‑read conditional ladder in the i915 driver so that newer GRAPHICS_VER values (>=11) are handled first, improving readability and making future platform extensions clearer.
Updates the copy of struct vmcb_control_area in KVM nSVM selftests to match the kernel's newer definition, allowing the tests to cover newly added VM control features.

The patch removes the buddy prefetch step in free_pcppages_bulk, arguing that under the zone lock the prefetch offers little benefit and adds overhead, thus simplifying the bulk free path and reducing instruction count.
Adds a PowerPC PMU self‑test that checks enabling branch stack does not crash, exercising the recent crash‑fix code path using a software cycles event.
The patch adds error handling in ftpm_mod_init(): if driver_register() fails, it now unregisters the ftpm_tee_plat_driver before returning, fixing a resource leak.
Updates the max310x serial driver to fill the rs485_supported field, documenting which serial_rs485 capabilities the hardware provides.
The patch refactors HOP functions in the MMU V1 driver to use newly defined shift/mask arrays, simplifying the code and improving maintainability.

The patch lowers the log level for failures of devm_thermal_of_zone_register() from error to debug, because -ENODEV is expected when a thermal zone is absent in DT, preventing unnecessary error messages.
The patch changes the USB control-message timeout used when reading EDID in the udl DRM driver to the standard 5‑second USB timeout constant, aligning it with other driver code.

Updates the amdgpu DRM driver to skip programming gfxhub_v3_0_3 system aperture registers for SR‑IOV virtual functions, as those registers are removed from the RLCG access range; the host now handles them.
The patch removes the vgpu->released field and its sanity‑check in the i915 GVT driver because VFIO core already manages vGPU lifecycle, simplifying the driver code.
The patch removes the arch_has_empty_bitmaps field from the x86 resctrl code, stating that min_cbm_bits alone suffices to validate CBM support, and updates related code accordingly.
Adds a function to query RAS poison mode in the amdgpu driver, notes SRIOV guests need not query it, and renames the function for clarity, simplifying the code.
The patch changes the ata_port struct field fastdrain_cnt from unsigned long to unsigned int because it is only ever assigned from 32‑bit values, reducing its size without altering behavior.
The commit changes the is_partially_uptodate helper to accept a folio instead of a page, updating its signature and related type usage to reflect byte counts, improving clarity and correctness.
The commit reorders the entries of CONFIG_SURFACE_PLATFORMS in RISC‑V defconfig files to match the order produced by savedefconfig, without altering any functional behavior.
The patch corrects the selection of the microengine (ME) field in the map_queue packet for GFX11, ensuring the appropriate ME is used for graphics, compute, or scheduling.
The commit modifies traceon/traceoff trigger handling so that they affect only the specific tracing instance rather than the global tracing state, fixing confusing behavior for users.
The patch adds a new helper function mcp251xfd_is_fd_mode() to detect CAN-FD mode and replaces scattered inline checks with calls to this function, improving code readability and maintainability.
The patch simplifies the BPF self‑tests by deleting the mount/umount of /sys and /sys/fs/bpf performed in open_netns and close_netns, eliminating unnecessary, error‑prone steps.

The patch changes the ssd130x DRM driver to obtain the plane state via drm_atomic_get_new_plane_state() instead of accessing the .state field directly, aligning with the atomic API. No functional behavior is altered.
The patch changes the vCPU field 'sysregs_loaded_on_cpu' from a simple boolean to a proper state flag in KVM arm64, updating its definition and related checks to reflect host‑only state handling.
The patch adds a forward declaration of struct folio in cacheflush.h so that code including this header compiles without warnings about an unknown type.
The patch changes the mt7921 driver to stop discarding received frames that use VHT MCS indices 10‑11, which the hardware can handle, correcting an incorrect drop behavior.
Adds a new device‑tree property and binding to expose the CIU clock phase control of the SDMMC controller via the system manager, enabling software to configure clock phase.
The patch adds a free() call for the structure holding parsed command‑line arguments in rtla/osnoise, ensuring it is released before the tool exits, thus eliminating a memory leak.
Adds handling for SubVP Dynamic Refresh Rate (DRR) cases: avoids VSYNC lock, uses firmware for manual trigger on DCN32/321, and introduces a command bit to flag SubVP DRR.
The commit renames the reference‑counting helpers in the rxe RDMA driver: rxe_add_ref() becomes rxe_get() and rxe_drop_ref() becomes rxe_put(), improving naming consistency and readability.
Adds a swap_free() call in try_to_unmap() when arch_unmap_one() fails, undoing a prior swap_duplicate() to prevent leaks and memory corruption in the COW/GUP pin handling path.

The patch introduces a cs_dsp library for ALSA, providing APIs that let HDA drivers expose CS_DSP DSP controls to userspace via ALSA controls, and fixes the Kconfig dependency for CONFIG_SND_HDA_CS_DSP_CONTROLS.
Tag commit marking Linux 5.19 release candidate 6; no source code modifications.
The patch updates KVM x86 MMU code to automatically refresh iter->old_spte after a failed cmpxchg, removing redundant manual reads and simplifying the logic.
The commit adds code to the hisi I2C driver to obtain the bus clock frequency via the generic clock framework, using either a clock reference or the clk_rate property, falling back as needed.
The patch adds a printk that logs the gap end size, which reflects the number of physical address bits on UV platforms.
Initializes the missing vqs_list_lock in vdev_info_init() to stop virtio_test from hanging in __vring_new_virtqueue().

Implements a new hot‑page selection algorithm for NUMA‑balancing memory tiering using hint‑page‑fault latency, adds promotion rate limiting and automatic hot‑threshold adjustment, reuses struct page bits, and provides a debugfs interface.
Adds Chinese translation of the Device Tree changesets documentation (docs/zh_CN/devicetree/changesets.rst).

The patch corrects a size‑mismatched cast in the LSE atomic implementation for arm64, replacing an unsigned long* cast with a pointer of the appropriate size, eliminating a -Warray-bounds warning without changing generated code.
The commit moves the extract‑cert script from scripts/ to certs/, updates the Makefile to use the new path, and modifies the build so the script is compiled only when required.
The patch changes the stmmac driver to allow MTU changes while the interface is up by releasing and reopening the driver and initializing the port filter, eliminating the EBUSY error.

The patch moves the KVM x86 PMU operations structure into the init ops table and marks it __initdata, reducing memory footprint and making the original ops inaccessible after initialization to avoid accidental modifications.
The commit removes an outdated entry for max77693.txt from the MAINTAINERS file that was re‑added by a merge conflict, correcting the documentation after the file was converted to YAML.
The commit updates the QCOM SM8350 pinctrl device‑tree binding to stop marking the 'function' property as required for pins that are not GPIOs, fixing validation errors for such pins.
Adds a BPF self‑test that reproduces a WARN_ON_ONCE triggered by a decl_tag in a function prototype return type, exercising btf_type_id_size checks.
The patch adds a guard in the RTC self‑test suite to detect the absence of an RTC device and skip the test, avoiding unnecessary failures when the hardware is not present.

The patch updates fbtft_init_display() to use fbtft_par_dbg_hex() for printing the init sequence, because the buffer holds signed 16‑bit values. The previous printing ignored the signed type, so the change corrects the debug output.
The patch adds a guard in hv_netvsc to delay VF registration until the host sends the VF association message, eliminating a race that could break the VF path during VM boot.
Adds an mm reference when queuing a range to the SVM deferred list and drops it after processing, ensuring the mm struct stays valid and preventing mm_count leaks in the amdkfd driver.

Adds optional prepare_streaming and unprepare_streaming callbacks to the vb2 queue ops, allowing drivers to claim and release streaming resources when VIDIOC_STREAMON/OFF is called instead of waiting for start_streaming.

The patch adds logic to invalidate the existing firmware session before a relogin when the authentication application starts, preventing repeated login attempts (thrashing) in N2N configurations where the remote WWPN is larger than the local adapter.
The patch adds reference‑count handling to the raw MIDI output buffer during snd_rawmidi_drain_output and checks the count on close, preventing concurrent buffer resize while draining.
The patch moves several exported extent_io_tree helper functions from the core file to extent-io-tree.c, consolidating helpers that don’t rely on tree_search() and reducing the core file size.
Adds a __vcpu_run() helper to KVM selftests so tests can invoke the KVM_RUN ioctl without triggering internal asserts, simplifying test code.
Adds mt7915_set_radar_background and related MCU routines to configure a dedicated DFS receive chain, enabling zero‑wait DFS (CAC detection on rdd2) in the mt76 driver.
Adds a device‑tree entry for RK3399 VOPs defining the gamma LUT memory region, enabling gamma control support on that hardware.

The patch disables the KVM_HC_CLOCK_PAIRING hypercall when a vCPU has tsc_always_catchup enabled, because the hypercall causes an infinite loop in pvclock_read_retry. It also adjusts warning and return code handling.
Adds a missing @server parameter description to the kernel-doc comment of smb311_update_preauth_hash() to silence documentation warnings, without changing code behavior.
Adds entries for Qualcomm QDU1000 and QRU1000 SoC identifiers to the arm/qcom,ids device‑tree binding header, extending supported SoC list.

The patch corrects the error‑checking logic for platform_get_irq() in the ipaq‑micro MFD driver, changing a null (zero) check to a <0 check because the function returns a negative error code on failure.
The patch updates rcutorture to use the helper kthread_run_on_cpu() instead of separate calls to kthread_create_on_node, kthread_bind, and wake_up_process, reducing code complexity.

The patch refactors the lpfc driver’s handling of SLI‑3/SLI‑4 RSCN, SCR, RDF, EDC and FARPR paths, replacing direct SLI‑3 iocb field accesses with generic get/set helpers and separating SLI‑3 and SLI‑4 specific code, making SLI‑4 the primary interface.

The commit restructures i915 VBT handling by separating panel‑specific data from global data, moving parsing to the output probing stage, storing it per connector, and dropping an unused micro‑optimization.
The patch deletes an unused assignment to the variable 'bytes' in sound/pci/echoaudio/midi.c, eliminating a dead‑store warning from clang static analysis.
The commit adds a platform data structure for Intel Agilex to the dwc2 USB driver, noting that the DWC2 IP on this platform lacks clock‑gating support.
The patch removes the _bh annotation from all rxrpc spinlocks because packet processing moved to an I/O thread and RCU callbacks no longer hold those locks, cleaning up now‑unnecessary annotations.
The commit updates the ti-dac5571 IIO DAC driver to use the newer i2c .probe_new() callback, adding explicit device ID handling because .probe_new() lacks the i2c_device_id argument.
The patch removes unused conditionals and driver options from the Qualcomm QMP UFS PHY driver, simplifying the code and eliminating dead paths.

Adds a reset of the GCC_SDCC_BCR register during each fresh initialization of the MSM SDHC controller, clearing previous power states to prevent the observed software reset timeout where the reset never completes.

The patch updates the K210 device‑tree for the Canaan board, splitting the timer node into two with correct interrupt arrays, eliminating dtbs_check warnings about non‑standard interrupt configuration.
Adds the 'qcom,msm8974' compatible string to the QCOM CCI I2C dt-binding, documenting support for the MSM8974 chip with two I2C masters.

The patch loads the actual VA bits (vabits_actual) during the resume path on ARM64, aligning it with the updated __cpu_setup() that now receives the VA size in x0, fixing boot failures on 52‑bit builds.
Adds error handling to ssi_init() in the OMAP SSI driver: checks platform_driver_register() return value and unregisters ssi_pdriver if registration fails, preventing stale registration.
Updates bio_copy_data_iter to handle offsets in destination bio_vecs, restoring correct copying behavior needed by bcache when bios contain partial pages.
Adds support for a reset‑GPIO to the onboard USB hub driver, releasing the reset line after power‑up and asserting it before power‑down.
The patch removes unused includes of_irq.h and of_platform.h from the 8250_dw serial driver and adds the missing mod_devicetable.h, aligning the driver’s header list with actual usage.
The patch changes a left‑shift of a signed 32‑bit integer by 31 bits in __mdiobus_register to use an unsigned type, eliminating undefined behavior flagged by UBSAN.
The patch updates DRM EDID parsing callbacks to treat struct detailed_timing pointers as const, preventing their modification during parsing.

The patch updates the xhci driver to also block U2 link power management for USB3 devices on tier‑2+ hubs when Intel tier policy disallows LPM, adding an early policy check to skip unnecessary commands.
The patch deletes a return variable in rtw_wx_get_essid of the r8188eu driver that was always zero and never overwritten, simplifying the function.

The patch adds a condition that skips starting the ext4lazyinit background thread when the filesystem is mounted read‑only, because block allocation and bitmap prefetching are unnecessary in that mode.
The commit updates the STM32 device‑tree source to rename pinctrl nodes to the standard 'pinctrl' name, eliminating warnings introduced by the recent pinctrl.yaml addition.
The commit updates the dt-bindings hwmon ntc-thermistor maintainer list, removing Naveen Krishna Chatradhi because his email bounces. No code or functional change, only metadata.
The commit updates the kernel-doc script to replace its custom error handling with Pod::Usage, integrating documentation printing and simplifying argument parsing.
Adds ability for the TPS68470 clock driver to accept multiple consumer platform data entries, enabling several sensors to share the same clock.
The commit introduces a new CAN line‑discipline driver (can327) that enables ELM327 OBD‑II adapters to act as cheap CAN interfaces, with accompanying documentation and minor style tweaks.
The patch adds a missing space to the heading row of the ext4 blockmap documentation table, realigning cells and removing the Sphinx 'Malformed table' warning that prevented the table from loading.

Updates the mmio thermal driver to use the new generic OF initialization API, converting its ops to thermal_zone_device_ops and registering the zone with the new API, simplifying and modernizing the code.

Updates the MT8365 mutex module array to use the newly added DDP_COMPONENT_DITHER0 enum index, matching earlier SoC changes. No functional behavior is altered; the change is purely for code consistency.

The patch modifies blk_crypto_sysfs_register/unregister to accept a gendisk pointer, using the existing gendisk during sysfs registration, preparing the block layer for upcoming sysfs handling changes.

The patch removes an incorrect spinlock (css_set_lock) around kernfs_walk_and_get, which may sleep, and adds a helper for the default hierarchy, ensuring proper locking and preventing sleep under a spinlock.
Adds the enable-strobe-pulldown property to the Rockchip eMMC PHY in the NanoPi4 device tree, re‑enabling an internal pull‑down that was previously disabled and caused HS400 mode I/O errors.
The commit adds support for DSD audio bit formats (DSD_U8, DSD_U16_LE, DSD_U32_LE) to the fsl_sai driver in the ASoC subsystem, extending its capabilities.
The patch adds missing cleanup calls in the probe and resources_setup error paths of the sun8i_a83t MIPI CSI-2 driver, mirroring the existing remove function to avoid resource leaks on failure.
Adds a prefix to macros in the gpio-f7188x driver to keep the GPIO namespace clean, without altering any functional behavior.

The patch makes reads from /dev/urandom attempt a best‑effort entropy generation; if it succeeds the RNG is initialized, otherwise behavior is unchanged, improving safety without forcing initialization.
Reorders rtc‑cmos driver initialization so cmos_wake_setup() runs after cmos_do_probe() sets driver data, eliminating a NULL‑pointer dereference in rtc_handler() on boot.
The patch corrects a typo in the IOAT DMA engine module description, changing "idel" to "idle". It only modifies a textual string, with no functional impact on the driver.
The patch revises numerous comments in mm/vmscan, changing mentions of 'pages' to 'folios' after the folio conversion, without modifying any executable code.
Updates the AD5380 IIO DAC driver to use i2c's .probe_new() callback, adding explicit device‑id lookup because .probe_new() lacks the i2c_device_id argument.
The patch renames iscsi_conn_queue_work() to iscsi_conn_queue_xmit() in the iSCSI driver to better describe its role of queuing transmit operations, without altering functionality.
The patch replaces atomic_long_cmpxchg with atomic_long_try_cmpxchg in __io_account_mem, removing an extra compare and simplifying code, with no functional change.
The patch removes now‑redundant validation checks in iommu_release_device and stops freeing fwspec structures that are already handled by core code, simplifying the release path.
The commit corrects a misspelled identifier 'postion' to 'position' in the IB/qib driver, fixing a typo in the source code.
Adds a #reset-cells property to the Mediatek MT8192/MT8195 device‑tree bindings, referencing existing infra_ao reset definitions and setting the cell count to 1.
The commit adds a PCI device ID for Intel 5 Series/3400 to the ALSA HDA driver, treating variant 0x3b57 like 0x3b56, enabling HDMI/DP audio via i915.
Fixes selftest timer code to correctly propagate child process errors by using macros to extract the waitpid-style return value instead of returning system() directly, which was always masked to 0.
The patch expands the ethtool ringparam structures and set/get handlers to expose the driver’s tx_push setting, enabling configuration via ethtool -G/g.
The patch deletes an unnecessary 'return' statement from a void function in the ALSA hda/via driver, cleaning up dead code because a return in a void function has no effect.
The patch modifies kernel config logic so rcuscale can be built without automatically enabling RCU Tasks in CONFIG_PREEMPT_NONE kernels, reducing kernel size and tracing complexity.
Adds checks for rxe_get() return values in RDMA/rxe tasklets to detect failure when a queue pair's reference count has dropped to zero, preventing use of a freed object.
Adds a teardown routine that frees tagger-owned storage during DSA switch driver unbind, correcting a missing cleanup that caused a memory leak and potential use‑after‑free.
The patch modifies io_uring to reuse a hash‑list node as storage for two 64‑bit values that must be returned in CQE32, enabling extra add‑operation results to be conveyed.
Updates selftests/bpf/test_xdp_redirect to create a temporary network namespace instead of a hard‑coded name, preventing name collisions during testing.
The commit moves the calculation of the module_list size into the modules loop, simplifying the logic in the ASoC qdsp6 audioreach driver.

Adds a check preventing existing DSA master devices from being attached as upper interfaces of other device types, except when the switch has no DSA tags. This enforces that LAG interfaces of DSA masters stay DSA masters and disallows adding new upper ports after creation.
Adds qca8k_bulk_read/write helpers to the DSA driver, enabling bulk packet I/O via management Ethernet, and updates FDB code to use them while reducing the register count for ARL table reads.

Modifies the mlx5 driver probe to query and probe active Subfunctions (SFs) during initialization, ensuring SF devices are recreated after parent driver reload when SFs and representors reside on different functions.

The patch replaces separate dma_set_mask() and dma_set_coherent_mask() calls in the qed driver with a single dma_set_mask_and_coherent() call, removes dead code, and folds qed_set_coherency_mask() into its sole caller, simplifying the driver.
Adds a Kconfig entry for AMD RPL Platform ACP audio drivers, allowing the drivers to be compiled when the new config option is selected, thus enabling support for those drivers.
The commit replaces the existing arm64 strcmp implementation with the latest upstream version from ARM Optimized Routines, adding Memory Tagging Extension (MTE) support.

The commit modifies the lpfc driver to derive VMID registration from fabric service parameters received during FLOGI_ACC instead of static module parameters, ensuring compatibility across different switch brands.
The patch adds a RAS poison creation handler to the amdgpu DRM driver and separates the UMC handler, preparing for future poison consumption handling.
The commit updates the maintainer entry in the rockchip,rk3399-cru.yaml binding file, replacing a former author with the current Rockchip clock maintainer as requested.
The patch stops incrementing i_version for EXT4_EA_INODE_FL inodes, which use i_version for reference counting, fixing test failures (xfstest ext4/026) when iversion is enabled.
The commit updates the default PSCI version reported to KVM arm64 guests to 1.1, so the PSCI_VERSION call now returns the newer version number.

The patch replaces all strlcpy calls with strscpy in the misc subsystem where the return value was unused, using a coccinelle script. The change is behavior‑equivalent and follows kernel coding advice.
Updates Qualcomm MSM8960 pin controller device-tree bindings to the new DT schema, renaming subnodes with '-state' and '-pins' suffixes to align with other Qualcomm schemas.
The patch frees allocated mount options on the error path of ntfs_fill_super(), removing a kmemleak reported by syzbot.
The patch deletes code that sent the EnableGfxImu message twice, ensuring it is only sent once in set_gfx_power_up_by_imu, cleaning up redundant operations in the amdgpu power management driver.
The commit introduces a macro that generates module parameters for DAMON statistics, allowing reuse across DAMON_RECLAIM and DAMON_LRU_SORT modules.
The commit adjusts the init/Kconfig test for CC_HAS_ASM_GOTO_TIED_OUTPUT so that when /bin/sh is dash, the test no longer fails due to stray newline characters, fixing the false‑negative detection.
The commit removes the separate MOD0 and SOF0 definitions for the Mediatek mt8195 SoC and reuses the existing mt8183 definitions, eliminating duplicate code.
Adds a hard limit of 256 retries for Ceph MDS requests to avoid overflow of the 8‑bit retry counter, which caused incorrect retry sequences.
Renames io_uring request handler functions so that preparation and issue sides follow a uniform naming pattern (io_<cmd>_prep and io_<cmd>) for better consistency.
The patch adds a guard in ocfs2_dlm_shutdown to skip cleanup of a DLM resource when it was never initialized, preventing a kernel crash that occurs after a mount failure in local mode.

The commit moves the 'calcs' folder, which contains floating‑point code, into the DML directory to isolate FPU operations as per project guidelines, and tweaks the build so it compiles when DCN is disabled. No functional changes are introduced.
The commit addresses a failure in the NTFS3 driver when handling highly fragmented attributes during attr_punch_hole, adding logic to locate the attribute correctly.

The patch fixes a memory‑leak bug in Btrfs where inode lists attached to ulist nodes were not freed during error handling in resolve_indirect_refs(). It replaces ulist_free() with free_leaf_list() and moves/simplifies that helper function.
The patch edits spte.h to delete a duplicated phrase "be split" in a comment, correcting a typo without altering code logic.
Introduces a helper function create_pidcomm in the perf timechart subsystem to encapsulate repeated code and allocation of per_pidcomm structures, improving readability and maintainability.
The patch corrects the computation of the memory‑region identifier (mr) in the read_reply() path of the rxe RDMA driver, fixing crashes observed in the rping benchmark during long runs.

The patch modifies the bq25890 driver to stop using pdata->regulator_init_data for the vsys regulator, ensuring only the vbus regulator gets that init data, which prevents duplicate regulator registration errors during probe.

The patch corrects migrate_pages() handling of THP migration failures when unmap_and_move returns -ENOSYS. It moves the failed THP from the 'from' list to 'ret_pages' to avoid double counting, and aligns failure processing with hugetlbfs for consistency.

The patch adds code to acquire the runtime‑pm (RPM) wakelock before accessing PXP hardware during driver unbind, mirroring a prior suspend fix, to stop the "RPM wakelock ref not held during HW access" warning.
The patch updates the PSP_BL_CMD enumeration in the amdgpu DRM driver so its values align with the definition used in the trusted OS component.
Patch modifies bonding flow key copying to use __struct_group() for IP/IPv6 addresses, removing fortify-string warnings about reading beyond field size.

The patch adds a transmit_in_progress_aborted flag to CEC driver logic. When a transmit is cancelled, it now marks the ongoing transmit as aborted and prevents the framework from retrying, avoiding overwriting the hardware buffer and garbled bus data.
The commit updates the MAINTAINERS file for the Broadcom USB driver, replacing Al Cooper with the author as the internal maintainer and adding an upstream maintainer entry.
The commit extracts timeout opcode definitions and their handling code from the existing io_uring implementation into a dedicated source file, improving modularity and code organization.
Renames struct udl_drm_connector to udl_connector and introduces a macro for upcasting from drm_connector, with no functional changes.
The patch deletes the unused prototype __arch_set_user_pkey_access() from the x86/pkeys code because the function is neither defined nor referenced.

The patch removes the unused reg_from_user() and reg_to_user() helper functions in the KVM arm64 code and replaces their calls with the standard get_user()/put_user() primitives, simplifying the code path used by invariant checks.
The commit updates the DSA networking documentation, correcting several typographical, grammatical, and punctuation errors without altering code or functionality.
The patch edits Documentation/process/changes.rst, replacing the explicit version number with the placeholder 'latest' (or 'current'), so the document stays accurate for future kernel releases.
The patch removes the mutex lock/unlock around the bvalid IRQ handler in the rockchip-inno-usb2 PHY driver, stating that IRQ clearing is atomic and the lock is unnecessary.
The patch adjusts tcp_bpf_recvmsg_parser() to return the same error codes as the TCP stack, fixing mismatched EAGAIN and other errors that confused applications and added latency.
Adds missing ida_simple_remove() in the probe error path to prevent a resource leak and replaces deprecated ida_simple_get()/remove() with ida_alloc()/free() in the alcor_pci driver.

The commit reverts a recent change that filled the DCN315 clock table using dcfclk values. The revert is done because the firmware leaves those entries empty when dcfclk states are disabled, leading to a no‑read/underflow condition. Restoring the previous behavior fixes the issue.
Adds a debugfs file amdgpu_reset_level to allow users to select and block specific GPU reset types, with mode2 reset disabled by default.

The patch updates KVM arm64 vgic handling to read pending/active state from the physical distributor for hardware‑mapped interrupts, correcting cases where the virtual register reports wrong pending status, such as after acknowledging a timer interrupt.

The patch replaces manual bitwise masking for PLANE_WM_BLOCKS_MASK with REG_FIELD_PREP/GET macros and adds REG_FIELD_GET usage in skl_wm_level_from_reg_val() to improve code consistency and avoid size mismatches.
The commit deletes an unused forward declaration from the PWM driver header (pwm.h). The declaration was only required for a previously removed dbg_show callback, so the change cleans up dead code.

The patch simplifies the ipa_table_init_add() API by replacing opcode and separate memory region IDs with two flags (filter and ipv6), uses ipa_table_mem() to select the correct memory region, and removes the assumption that a hashed table entry always exists.
The patch extracts all devlink‑related code from dsa.c and dsa2.c into a new devlink.c and creates a dedicated devlink.h, reducing file bloat and improving modularity.
The patch fixes a race in NR_FILE_MAPPED accounting for file or shmem huge pages by moving __mod_lruvec_page_state() to a safe location, preventing inflated "Mapped" values in /proc/meminfo.
The patch adds code to pass the io_uring locking state (issue_flags) into poll cancellation functions, ensuring they have the same lock context when they later need to acquire ->uring_lock.
Adds a compatible string for the Renesas RZ/V2L SoC's Mali‑G31 GPU in the dt‑bindings documentation, enabling the kernel to recognize this hardware.

The patch updates hugetlb_get_unmapped_area to use arch_get_mmap_base/end macros, moving those macros to a common header, fixing a regression where hugetlb could return addresses above the allowed range on ARM64 after enabling 52‑bit virtual addresses.

The commit updates perf stat printing functions to accept and propagate a pointer to struct outstate, adjusting evlist__print_counters() and its child calls, improving internal data flow for output handling.
The commit corrects the output of out-of-sync and packet-failure events by adding missing le32_to_cpu() conversions and printing atomic_read() values with %d, fixing incorrect display.
Adds ACPI ID support to enumerate the Cypress CCGX PD controller over the system I2C on AMD platforms, allowing the kernel driver to discover the client via ACPI.
The commit replaces a dead aer-inject URL in the PCI AER documentation with the correct link from pcieaer-howto.rst, updating documentation only.

Extracts a duplicated loop that patches entry fixup instructions in several PowerPC functions into a new helper function do_patch_entry_fixups() and updates callers, simplifying and de‑duplicating the code.
Deprecates the '#dma-channels' DT property for MMP DMA engine, switches drivers to use the new 'dma-channels' property while retaining compatibility.

The patch migrates MediaTek clock driver code from the legacy struct clk API to the newer struct clk_hw API, updating related structures and call sites via a coccinelle script while keeping temporary compatibility bridges.
Renames struct pcie_port to dw_pcie_rp across the DesignWare PCIe driver to match the dw_ prefix convention, enhancing naming consistency and readability.
The commit changes the DCN315 display driver to read its clock table from dcfclk instead of fclk and adds checks that reject empty pmfw tables, preventing invalid DAL clock values.
Adds missing kernel-doc annotation for the 'ab' parameter in dump_common_audit_data, removing documentation warnings.
Fixes a typo in the SC8180x pinctrl driver wakeirq map where gpio36 and gpio37 shared the same wakeirq number, allowing gpio37 to correctly trigger wake interrupts.
Updates an outdated comment in the IPA network driver to reflect that command info entries are no longer allocated after a prior change.
The commit edits the device tree for the sama5d27_wlsom1 board to stop forcing LDO2 regulator on continuously, because no driver uses it.

The patch lowers the severity of a warning about unclaimed register accesses in the i915 uncore driver to debug level, keeping the message visible for developers but stopping it from being emitted as a user‑visible warning.

The patch reorganizes KVM arm64 VGIC attribute handling by moving early vgic_{get,set}_common_attr() calls into the default case of a switch, deduplicates pending‑table handling, and cleans up vgic_v3_{get,set}_attr() calls.
The patch changes tve200_modeset_init() to return an explicit error code instead of an ambiguous value, silencing a smatch static‑analysis warning.
The patch adds a PCI device ID for the ADL‑S (Alder Lake‑S) GPU to the i915 driver, enabling recognition and initialization of this new hardware.
The patch removes the __func__ argument from dev_dbg calls in the Intel soundwire driver, relying on dynamic debug to provide module/function context, thus simplifying debug messages.
Updates the AMD DRM display driver SR watermark constants for DCN314, applying new hardware‑requested values across all memory types.
The patch makes the value argument of vfs_setxattr() const, because translations are no longer done there, and removes an unnecessary const cast in ovl_do_setxattr().

Updates thunderbolt KUnit tests to use the new kunit_test_suite() macro, avoiding module_init conflicts, and modifies Kconfig to enable the test when KUNIT_ALL_TESTS is set, allowing kunit_tool to run and parse results.
Adds a helper that asserts a file range has no ordered extents and calls it in fallocate, hole punching, zero range and reflink paths to ensure the range is clean before proceeding.
The patch changes i915 selftests to stop using kthread_stop() and instead use kthread_work with explicit signaling, avoiding failures caused by the new kthread_stop() signal assertion.
The patch adds command‑line options to the xdpsock sample allowing users to specify destination and source MAC addresses for transmit‑only mode, extending its functionality.
The patch changes the printk format string in xgbe‑drv.c to use %x instead of %hx, matching integer promotion rules and silencing clang -Wformat warnings.
The patch modifies the MIPS jump_label branch range check to cast the upper bound to a signed long, performing a signed comparison and avoiding warnings caused by negative offsets.
The patch changes the SPI driver to store statistics in per‑CPU u64_stats_t structures, removing costly spin_lock_irqsave() calls and yielding a measurable latency reduction.
The patch enables the GENERIC0_INT interrupt for graphics/compute pipelines in the amdgpu driver, allowing the RLC to be notified to access indirect registers that the CP cannot reach directly.
The patch deletes the unused reg pointer from the r8a73a4_cpg structure, makes it a local variable, and passes it to r8a73a4_cpg_register_clock(), simplifying initialization.

The patch corrects the error‑handling check in s10_ops_write_init(): the allocation function returns an ERR_PTR on failure, so the code now uses IS_ERR() instead of a NULL test, ensuring proper detection of allocation errors.

Adds a workaround for Parade PS8461E eDP MUX that loses snooped link‑rate data after power‑down. Forces re‑read of SUPPORTED_LINK_RATES at each link‑training start, preventing fallback to low‑quality mode and stabilising high link rates.
The patch replaces manual swapping of two variables in net2280.c with the generic swap() macro, removing temporary variables and silencing Coccinelle warnings.

The patch simplifies SetHwReg8188EU() in the r8188eu driver by removing the HW_VAR_H2C_FW_P2P_PS_OFFLOAD case, which only called another function, and invokes that function directly, cleaning up the HAL layer.
The patch adds a bounds check on the user‑supplied block index in ismt_access() to ensure it stays within 0‑255, preventing writes past the end of the DMA buffer and thus avoiding memory corruption.

The patch resolves a block device naming collision that occurs with multipath and shared namespaces by initializing head->shared before nvme_mpath_alloc_disk(), ensuring nvme_is_unique_nsid() correctly reports uniqueness.
Adds a BPF selftest exercising __user pointer tags, verifying that programs accessing user memory directly are rejected during verification.
The patch updates kernel documentation to clarify that SAVEKMSG_MAGIC[12] are not magic numbers but markers used when dumping dmesg into Chip RAM on Amiga with debug=ram.

The patch changes tfp410_fini() from returning an int (always zero) to returning void, reflecting that callers have no error to handle, and notes future similar changes for i2c and platform remove callbacks.
Adds a null-pointer check for sta_rates in mt7615_sta_rate_tbl_update to avoid dereferencing a NULL pointer when minstrel_ht_update_rates fails to allocate the rates array.
Adds a YAML file describing the LoongArch CPU interrupt controller bindings for device tree, enabling representation of 14 IRQs.
Adjusts batman‑adv interface traversal to no longer rely on unique iflink indices across network namespaces, adding netns checks and handling zero iflink cases.

The commit corrects the pinctrl driver for Nuvoton wpcm450 by handling the SCS3SEL and KBCCSEL fields that use inverted logic, ensuring the GPIO and special function selections are interpreted correctly.

The patch corrects a compile‑time check in the mlx5e kTLS TX path by replacing the wrong constant with TLS_DRIVER_STATE_SIZE_TX, ensuring the private TX TLS driver context size is validated correctly.
The patch modifies do_sys_name_to_handle to accept a const pointer for the path argument, adding a const qualifier to improve type safety and code correctness.

The patch replaces dev_err() calls with dev_err_probe() in the Qualcomm QMP UFS PHY driver’s probe function, simplifying error handling and automatically handling -EPROBE_DEFER, also recording defer reasons for debugfs.
The patch removes a duplicated word "we" from a comment in the bcache driver, cleaning up the documentation without altering code logic or behavior.
Adds a GETVXATTR operation to Ceph client/MDS, enabling clients to request directory and file layout vxattrs directly, handling JSON format for full layouts and supporting legacy format.
The commit deletes the unused irq_prepare_beacon_tasklet member from the recv_priv structure of the r8188eu driver, cleaning up dead code.
Adds support in the Intel SOF ES8336 ASoC driver for using a dedicated GPIO line to control the headphone jack, allowing independent control of speaker and headphone.
Adds a new display clock controller driver for SM6125 devices, allowing display drivers to probe and control their clocks.
The patch adds a diagnostic warning in ACPICA when the executer sleeps longer than 10 ms, to highlight potential boot‑time delays.

The patch changes the batadv-on-batadv code to lower the "Cannot find parent device" message from error to warning and rewrites the text, because the condition is only a skipped sanity check for macvtap devices.
Adds a null‑pointer check in amdgpu_smu_stb_debug_fs_init to avoid dereferencing when the SMU block is disabled, preventing crashes.
The patch updates __nvme_fc_abort_outstanding_ios() to restart the admin queue when needed, fixing a condition where the controller could not handle admin requests and caused I/O hangs.
The patch adds a new socket option SO_RCVMARK so that SO_MARK is returned in ancillary data from recvmsg(), and renames sock_recv_ts_and_drops() to sock_recv_cmsgs() to reflect its broader role.
The patch edits comments in the rtl8192e driver, deleting a duplicated word "new" to clean up the documentation.
The commit deletes the unused debug-leds driver from the OMAP ARM platform, removing its source files and build entries because it cannot be selected and serves no purpose.
The commit adjusts the reStructuredText in Documentation/security/SCTP.rst to correct title underline lengths, eliminating make htmldocs warnings.
Adds the static qualifier to internal symbols in arch/arm64/kernel/cpu_errata.c, limiting their visibility and silencing sparse warnings about undeclared symbols.

The patch adds a condition so the SCDC enable flag is only set when the HDMI interface supports > HDMI 1.4, preventing attempts to disable SCDC on Pi0-3 where the hardware register does not exist, thus removing a warning.
Updates the lis3lv02d I2C driver to use the newer .probe_new() callback instead of .probe, since the probe does not need the i2c_device_id argument.

The commit updates the MSM display device‑tree bindings by removing an incorrect interrupt‑flags cell from MDSS nodes, because the interrupt provider supplies only a single cell. This corrects the binding specification.
The patch restores proper initialization of the engine workaround list for Gen2‑3 i915 platforms that was broken by a prior change, ensuring the list is always set up even when no workarounds exist.
The commit deletes an outdated comment in btrfs_search_slot() that described old custom lock behavior, because the code now uses rw semaphores. No functional code changes are made.
The commit adds support for DisplayPort PSR2 (Panel Self Refresh) by defining two new DPCD bit fields as specified in eDP 1.5, and corrects a typo in the code.
The patch deletes duplicate calls to ras_late_init in the HDP RAS block of the amdgpu DRM driver, eliminating unnecessary initialization.
The patch removes an unnecessary cast when assigning the result of of_device_get_match_data() to a pointer in the j721e PCI driver, because the function already returns void*.

The patch makes tcp_cdg_release() idempotent so that tcp_disconnect() can be invoked repeatedly without causing a double‑free when CDG congestion control is active, fixing the crash observed with MPTCP.
The patch modifies the v4l2-ctrls code to allocate memory for array fields inside struct ctrl_ref, enabling drivers to later adjust the array size dynamically.

The commit changes the DHCOM STM32 device tree to use MCO2 as the RMII clock for the DWMAC Ethernet controller instead of ETH_CLK, allowing PLL4_P to run at 100 MHz, which boosts SD/MMC performance and reduces EMI.
The commit adds runtime WARN_ON_ONCE checks in the qcom-qmp-pcie PHY driver probe to ensure required configuration masks (pwrdn_ctrl and phy_status) are provided, catching missing settings early.
Adds a compatible string for the AST2600 EVB A1 board in the aspeed device tree, allowing the kernel to recognize this board variant.
Adds an assertion that the extent map tree is write‑locked before clear_em_logging() merges entries, ensuring the required lock is held.

The patch changes rcu_tasks_trace_pregp_step() to IPI each CPU, adding the running task to the holdout list and recording its RCU Tasks Trace state, ensuring running tasks are considered during grace‑period processing.
The patch updates the scale minimum and maximum macro definitions for the BMA400 accelerometer driver so they correctly reflect the sensor's sensitivity per LSB across all supported ranges.
Fixes the sparx5 driver’s packet extraction to correctly handle packets whose length isn’t a multiple of 4, preventing extra checksum bytes from being processed and correcting endian handling.
The patch removes an unnecessary comparison in find_va_links() of vmalloc, simplifying the traversal logic because the invariant va_start <= va_end already guarantees the check.
Adds a central definition for the 'linux,input-type' property in dt-bindings input.yaml and updates all existing bindings to use it, consolidating documentation and reducing duplication.
The patch changes the return type of a Sparx5 network driver function from bool to int, matching the actual error‑integer value it returns. No functional behavior changes, only type correction.
Corrects a spelling mistake in a comment of selftests/vm/pkeys, altering only the comment text.
The patch replaces calls to call_rcu() with call_rcu_hurry() in the rcu sync code to avoid power‑saving induced slowdown, restoring previous behavior.
Adds entries for new Qualcomm SoCs (SM8350, SC8280XP, SM8450) and PMICs (SA8540P, etc.) to the socinfo driver, enabling kernel to recognize these platforms.
Replaces the multiline macro vt6655_mac_word_reg_bits_on in the vt6655 driver with an equivalent static inline function, because checkpatch.pl rejects multiline macros. Adjusts all uses accordingly.
The patch updates the 8250_omap serial driver to replace its custom Tx‑queue advancement code with the generic uart_xmit_advance() helper, aiming for code unification and increased robustness.

The patch deletes now‑unused bio_advance() calls in __split_and_process_bio and __send_duplicate_bios after a prior change eliminated the looping logic, cleaning up dead code in the device‑mapper subsystem.
The patch extends perf's hypervisor thread handling by adding a guest_cpu field, allowing identification of the guest CPU associated with each VCPU thread during profiling.
The commit enables the InterTouch (rmi4) functionality for ThinkPad P1 G3 by adjusting driver defaults, adding support for a hardware feature that was previously disabled.
Adds a hardware workaround (Wa_16013835468) in the i915 DRM driver to handle PSR2 mode with delayed vblank, addressing a known display bug.
Adds the const qualifier to static initialization tables and rtl8xxxu_rfregs in the rtl8xxxu Wi‑Fi driver, making these arrays read‑only.
The commit updates the mt8195 pinctrl device‑tree bindings by adding a wrapping subnode for pin configurations within pinctrl groups and provides an example, enabling more flexible pin setup.

Adds a hardware presence check before probing the xilinx zynqmp‑sha driver, avoids loading on non‑Xilinx platforms, simplifies driver registration with module_platform_driver(), and adds a firmware dependency.

The patch refactors the qla2xxx driver’s EDIF BSG interface: it adds a version field to the BSG structure, introduces a version check, and removes obsolete interfaces and fields, preparing for future extensions.
Corrects a spelling typo in a comment of the RDMA opa_vnic driver; the change is limited to documentation and does not affect code behavior.
Adds device tree binding definitions for the Qualcomm SM6350 camera clock controller, enabling support for this hardware in the kernel's DT schema.
Expands rtl8xxxu driver chip‑cut detection to cover all cut letters A‑P, replacing the previous "unknown" output for cuts beyond E by updating the mapping logic.

The patch separates the handling of HK_FLAG_WQ and HK_FLAG_DOMAIN cpumasks, giving each housekeeping flag its own cpumask and requiring individual fetches, preventing mixed flag calls. This prepares the code for future cpuset support and runtime modification of boot‑parameter cpulists.
The commit updates the MAINTAINERS file to change John Garry's email address for arm64 perf tooling, reflecting his current contact information.
Deletes an unnecessary .owner assignment in spl2sw_driver because the core sets it automatically, silencing a cocci warning.
Adds power‑management support to the microchip PCI1XXXX SPI driver by implementing suspend and resume callbacks that store the device configuration on suspend and restore it on resume.
The commit corrects the baud‑rate mapping for FTDI SIO USB‑serial devices, adding proper support for the 300 bps rate that was previously incorrectly treated as 9600 bps.
Adds AMD-specific handling to convert IBS raw data into the generic perf_mem_data_src structure, enabling PERF_SAMPLE_DATA_SRC support for tools like perf mem and c2c.
The patch adds a free() call for the orom_data buffer when ice_read_flash_module() fails, eliminating a memory leak caused by an earlier vzmalloc allocation.

Adds two BPF selftests that ensure passing read‑only memory to a global BPF function or kfunc is rejected and that writing to a read‑only PTR_TO_MEM pointer is caught, exposing a regression before prior patches.
Adds a sysfs "label" attribute for ChromeOS EC sensors, mapping known locations to readable strings, and removes the old non‑standard "location" attribute and its struct field.
Updates the lx2160a device tree CAN node to define fsl,clk-source as a uint8 using '/bits/8 <0>', eliminating a build warning.
The commit adds Roman Gushchin as a co-maintainer for the memory controller (memcg) subsystem, updating the MAINTAINERS file with his contact information and acknowledgments.
The patch delays exposing iscsi_cls_conn in sysfs until after iscsi_conn's dd_data is initialized, preventing a NULL pointer dereference, and removes an unused iscsi_create_conn function.

The patch changes the cast of the value returned by of_device_get_match_data() in drivers/mmc/host/mxcmmc.c to (uintptr_t) before casting to enum mxcmci_type, solely to silence a clang -Wvoid-pointer-to-enum-cast warning.

Extends can_changelink() to also consider can_priv::bitrate_const when validating netlink bit‑rate changes, enabling configuration of fixed‑bitrate CAN devices without a dummy do_set_bittiming callback.
Adds xhci_free_stream_ctx() on the error path of xhci_alloc_stream_info() to release stream_ctx_array, preventing a memory leak when allocation fails.

The patch adds a NULL‑check after ioremap() in the ray_cs driver, ensuring that local->sram and related pointers are validated before use, preventing possible null‑pointer dereference and spurious dev_dbg calls.

The patch replaces schedule_delayed_work() with mod_delayed_work() in vsock_connect() and undoes an extra sock_hold() when the work is already pending, eliminating a reference‑count leak reported by syzbot.
The commit rewrites the I2C binding documentation for Atmel/Microchip SoCs from the legacy format to a JSON‑schema based Device Tree binding format, updating the dt‑bindings repository accordingly.
The patch moves the LCOUNT constant definition from inline code to a dedicated header file in the Intel SoundWire driver, improving code organization and visibility.
The patch changes map_block() so it only assigns a block ID handle when get_hw_block_id() succeeds, preventing the use of a possibly valid ID (0) when the hardware call fails.
Adds a missing WARN_ON check for the VF pointer in ice_vsi_rebuild, preventing a null-pointer dereference that caused a call trace during VF reset.
